function.description: Read a file from the workspace.
function.name: read_file

function.description: List files and directories in a workspace directory.
function.name: list_files

path.description: Directory path; use '.' for workspace root

function.description: Search workspace code using literal or Rust regex (no PCRE2). Respects gitignore; skips hidden/private/cache/dependency/binary files. Returns bounded paths, lines and UTF-8 byte columns.
function.name: search_code

function.description: Read 1-based inclusive lines of a UTF-8 workspace file; at most 200 lines/2 MiB file. Output is bounded; check truncated/next_start_line. Investigation evidence only, not a repair/test.
function.name: read_file_range

function.description: Read Git status inside Workspace, including staged/unstaged/untracked and rename paths. At most 200 entries; truncated is never a clean assertion. Does not change the Index.
function.name: git_status

function.description: Read tracked-file unified diff: unstaged is Working Tree vs Index; staged is Index vs HEAD. No pager/external diff/textconv. Bounded to 300 lines/24000 characters; check truncated. Untracked content is absent: use git_status and read_file_range. Private paths are excluded.
function.name: git_diff

function.description: Precisely update UTF-8 files using full-file SHA256 and unique non-overlapping old_text, or add new files in existing directories. Default dry_run=true previews only. Write requires patch_mode=write and explicit dry_run=false. No tests or commands run. Each update requires op, path, expected_sha256 and edits (each edit: old_text and new_text); each add requires op, path and content. No extra fields at any level. A successful preview does not grant write permission. Reread and rebuild on stale_file_hash/anchor conflicts; never replay blindly. Hidden/private paths denied.
function.name: apply_patch

changes.description: Use the declared update/add structure only. After a successful preview, if target files and intended edits are unchanged, reuse the same changes and set only dry_run=false. If changes are revised, preview again.

dry_run.description: true previews only (default); false requests a write, still requiring patch_mode=write.

function.description: Run a Python test/check command after separate one-call human approval. argv array, no shell string. Modes are host_confirm (NO OS isolation) or macos_readonly (verified Seatbelt, workspace read-only, network denied). Only python/python3, pytest/ruff via validated Python, or uv run --no-sync python ... . Prefer omitting optional cwd to run at workspace root; explicit cwd must be an existing safe workspace-relative directory. Nonzero completed exit is real failure feedback, not a passed test. Output/time/temp limits apply.
function.name: run_command

cwd.description: Optional; prefer omitting cwd to run at workspace root ('.'). If set, use an existing workspace-relative directory; no absolute paths, '..' segments or symlinks. Do not use the absolute host project or temporary evaluation path.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional; omit to use the configured safe default. Explicit values cannot exceed this maximum.

function.description: Create a 2-6 step plan for this task only when multiple operations are needed.
function.name: create_plan

function.description: Update a plan step in order. Completion requires successful real tool execution.
function.name: update_plan

explanation: AgentLoop constructor adds create_plan/update_plan after the initial registry snapshot; the fixed Git commit already seals their code. No manifest or raw result altered.
